payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the previous state of the art in the context of the AI2 WinoGrande Challenge, identifying RoBERTa as the benchmark model prior to the T5 model's performance improvement.

claims.text: The previous state of the art was based on RoBERTa, an encoder-only transformer architecture.
The T5 model achieved a performance improvement of over five points compared to the previous state of the art.
